law_name: Liberia Intellectual Property Act, 2016 (Title 24, Liberian Code of Laws Revised; approved 14 June 2016; replaced the 1997 Copyright Law)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (s. 9.20; literary, musical and artistic works other than photographs; joint works from death of last surviving author; audiovisual, sound recordings, anonymous works and broadcasts 50 years)
enforcement_body: Liberia Intellectual Property Office (LIPO), Copyright Department
notes: Berne (Paris Act) in force 8 Mar 1989 (WIPO notification 122); WTO member since 14 Jul 2016 (Baker McKenzie). WCT/WPPT status not found. Spoor calls the law 'Industrial Property Act 2014' effective 22 Jul 2016: title/date conflict across sources.
